map.根据池塘面积、水深、品种和目标溶氧提升量，估算所需增氧机功率与台数。: Estimate the required aerator power and unit count from pond area, water depth, species and the target dissolved oxygen increase.

map.💡 公式：需氧量(kg) = 面积 × 水深 × 666.67 × 溶氧提升量: 💡 Formula: oxygen demand (kg) = area × depth × 666.67 × dissolved oxygen increase × 0.001 × species coefficient; required power (kW) = oxygen demand × oxygen transfer efficiency (1.5 kgO₂/kW·h); unit count = power ÷ power per unit (rounded up).
map.新建或改造养殖池塘时，按水面面积、水深与养殖品种初配增氧机总功率与台数。: When building or renovating a grow-out pond, size the total aerator power and unit count from the water surface area, depth and cultured species.
map.高密度养殖（如对虾、黄颡鱼）夏季夜间溶氧风险高，需校核增氧能力是否够。: High-density culture (such as shrimp or yellow catfish) has a high night-time dissolved oxygen risk in summer, so the aeration capacity must be verified as sufficient.

map.以 10 亩精养鱼塘配置叶轮式增氧机: Sizing paddlewheel aerators for a 10-mu intensive carp pond
map.精养鲤鲫塘按单位面积 0.5 kW/亩估算，10 亩需总功率约 5 kW。选 1: For an intensive carp and crucian carp pond estimated at 0.5 kW per mu, 10 mu needs about 5 kW total. Choosing a 1.5 kW paddlewheel aerator gives unit count = 5 / 1.5 ≈ 3.3, rounded up to 4 units (allowing for standby and zoned placement). High-density or shrimp ponds can be raised to 0.6~0.75 kW per mu.
map.每亩配多少千瓦增氧机比较合适？: How many kilowatts of aeration per mu are appropriate?
map.常规精养鱼塘经验值为 0.3~0.5 kW/亩；南美白对虾、黄颡鱼等高耗氧品种或: The empirical value for ordinary intensive fish ponds is 0.3~0.5 kW per mu; high-oxygen-consumption species such as Pacific white shrimp or yellow catfish, and high-density culture, can be raised to 0.6~0.75 kW per mu. In practice it should also be judged together with water depth, water exchange conditions and night-time aeration duration.
map.叶轮式、水车式、微孔曝气怎么选？: How to choose between paddlewheel, water wheel and micro-bubble aeration?
map.叶轮式提水与上下水层交换强，适合深水位主养鱼塘；水车式推动水体循环、增氧均匀，适: Paddlewheel units have strong lift and upper/lower water exchange, suiting deep-water main-culture fish ponds; water wheel units drive circulation and aerate evenly, suiting shallow shrimp and crab ponds; micro-bubble aeration produces fine bubbles with high oxygen utilization but needs a matching blower, suiting high-level ponds and indoor recirculating water systems.
